About me

Currently: BScHons Computer Science at the University of Pretoria (2026). Open to graduate roles and internships in ML, data science and software development.

Work Ethic & Background

I'm a hardworking, curious and dedicated individual who thrives on being challenged to grow. I have strong technical knowledge paired with great collaborative abilities, and the project management experience to step into a leadership role when needed.

I completed my BSc IT at North-West University and am currently pursuing Honours in Computer Science at the University of Pretoria, with a focus on machine learning, data science and data engineering.
